title: Handy Haversacks
description: Parse bag containment rules to find which bags can hold shiny gold and how many bags it must contain.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse the rules with regex to build a graph: each bag maps to a list of `(count, color)` pairs it contains.

## Part 1

Build a reverse lookup (which bags contain each color) and BFS outward from `shiny gold` to find all bags that can transitively contain it.

## Part 2

BFS from `shiny gold` outward through the containment graph, multiplying counts as we descend. Each bag in the queue carries a multiplier representing how many copies are needed. Sum all counts and subtract 1 for the shiny gold bag itself.
